newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Alpha Credit Bank to cut loan, depo rates.
newsitem.headline: Greek Alpha Credit Bank to cut loan, depo rates.

text.p: Greece's largest private commercial bank, Alpha Credit Bank, will lower its deposit rates by 50 basis points and its lending prime rate and fixed mortgage rate by 50 basis points effective December 9, the bank said in a statement.

The bank cited expectations of falling inflation in cutting its deposit and lending rates that took its prime rate down to 16.75 percent and its fixed mortgage rate for Alpha 800 loans signed from December 9 to 11.75 percent.
Consumer loan and credit card VISA rates will be cut by 100 basis points but working capital loans for light industry will be steady at 14 percent, it added.
